extraction.Name: Nora Parkhurst
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Beltrami County, Minnesota (likely Red Lake or Leech Lake area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: she did apply for patent-in-fee, but she received her patent-in-fee, without request. Deponent further states that she made no protest
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: the land was mortgaged by herself, and that said mortgage was foreclosed
extraction.NOTES: She has seven children, five of whom are now attending the boarding school; her health has improved to some extent and she has or always has had comfortable means; she has received no aid from the Government, State, or County at any time; she was not defrauded of her property and the money she received for the land was well spent and satisfactory consideration; the Indian Office denied her [some request, text unclear]; affidavit sworn before notary in May 1929
